issues.title: Loan Simple leads receiving duplicate tasks in post-referral and other workflows
issues.desc: Home advisors and TCs were receiving duplicate tasks across multiple workflows including post-referral and sale pending. The root cause for Loan Simple leads was identified as a bugged filter related to LS lead associations, which was resolved with HubSpot support. A separate instance of duplicate tasks affected a Newrez sale pending lead that had its cashback status changed, causing it to qualify for both cashback and non-cashback workflows simultaneously.
issues.workaround: Review affected leads that received double tasks during the impact window and manually close out any duplicate tasks to avoid redundant follow-up.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not stopping when deal marked Closed Lost or Transferred
issues.desc: HAs were receiving post-referral workflow check-in tasks for deals that had already been marked as Closed Lost or Transferred. The workflow filters were not correctly excluding these terminal deal stages, causing tasks to continue firing. A tweak to the workflow filters was made on March 9th to resolve the issue.
issues.workaround: Manually cancel any open workflow tasks on deals that were marked Closed Lost or Transferred during the impact window.

issues.title: Offer Accepted workflow not re-enrolling deals that flip back to Committed then back to Offer Accepted
issues.desc: When a deal was moved from Offer Accepted back to Committed (due to a fallen contract) and then updated to Offer Accepted again, the workflow tasks to collect closing info did not re-trigger. This was because 'deal stage = Offer Accepted' was not listed as a re-enrollment criterion in the workflow. The re-enrollment criteria was updated to fix this.
issues.workaround: For deals that were toggled back to Offer Accepted during the impact window and did not receive TC tasks, manually enroll them in the Offer Accepted workflow.

issues.title: Automated emails showing previous loan officer after LO reassignment
issues.desc: When a loan officer was changed on a deal, automated emails continued to reference the previous LO rather than the updated one. The contact record in Dash showed the correct LO but workflow-triggered emails still pulled the old LO's information. The issue was resolved by Luis on the product side.
issues.workaround: For deals where the LO was changed during the impact window, manually resend any automated emails that referenced the incorrect loan officer.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not triggering for referral accepted on March 18th
issues.desc: An HA reported receiving no workflow tasks after a referral was made and accepted on March 18th. The root cause was identified as an error in how data was being pulled into the workflow filter, preventing the deal from being correctly evaluated for enrollment. The issue was escalated to the product team for resolution.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll affected deals from the March 18th impact window into the post-referral workflow using the manual enrollment option.

issues.title: Buyer credit SMS sent in Offer Accepted stage without credit amount populated
issues.desc: An SMS informing buyers of their credit amount was incorrectly triggering in the 'Offer Accepted' deal stage before closing information had been submitted to calculate the credit. The SMS should only send in the 'Sale Pending' stage once the credit amount is known. The issue was confirmed to be a Dash-triggered communication and was escalated to the product team.
issues.workaround: For buyers who received the incomplete credit SMS during the impact window, manually follow up with the correct buyer credit amount once closing information has been submitted.
